title: Vite build lacks its canonical origin
root_cause: The Vite configuration requires PUBLIC_ORIGIN at load time, but the build job does not provide it. Set the variable to the intended public site origin in the CI build environment.

relevant_evidence.why: Vite cannot load its configuration because PUBLIC_ORIGIN is absent.
The configuration explicitly checks the variable and throws when it is missing.
The build step runs without setting an environment variable.
